project.name: Ajwaa (أجواء)
project.description: High-performance client-side weather and live local time application built with vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
project.author: Mohamed Ibrahim Mustafa
project.architecturePattern: Layered Modular Architecture with Reactive Store and Unidirectional Data Flow

layers.name: Presentation Layer (View)
layers.responsibility: Renders UI components, captures user inputs, displays live clocks, SVG graphics, and atmospheric backgrounds.

files.role: Single-page application markup shell, SEO meta tags, and script loader.
Dedicated bilingual privacy policy document.
Dedicated bilingual terms of service and safety disclaimers.
Design tokens (color palettes, dark/light themes, typography, elevation, radii).
CSS reset, global typography, logical properties (RTL/LTR), accessibility focus.
Sticky header, application container, multi-column responsive grids, footer.
Glassmorphism cards, buttons, badges, hero card, bottom sheets, skeletons.
GPU-accelerated animated weather backgrounds (sun rays, stars, drifting clouds, rain streaks, dust particles).
Keyframe animations, staggered reveals, reduced-motion accessibility overrides.
Header bar with brand logo, live AR/EN switcher, search button, settings.
Hero card with giant temperature, live local clock (HH:MM:SS), timezone pill, and refresh button.
Dynamic alert banners based on weather severity thresholds.
24-hour horizontal scroll timeline highlighting the current hour.
Side-by-side cards for rain accumulation/dots and dust/AQI sparkline area chart.
7-tile metric grid with click-to-explain scientific advice modals.
Parabolic SVG solar trajectory arc with daylight remaining calculation.
Active tropical storms tracker with Haversine distance from current city.
7-day forecast cards with unified normalized weekly temperature range bars.
Bottom sheets and modal dialogs for City Picker, Settings, Onboarding, and Explanations.
Non-intrusive feedback snackbars.

layers.name: Application & State Management Layer
layers.responsibility: Coordinates application lifecycle, reactive state subscriptions, user settings, and DOM syncing.

files.role: Bootstrap coordinator, concurrent API orchestration, pull-to-refresh, lifecycle control.
Central reactive store implementing Subscribe/Publish and action dispatchers.
Configuration constants, brand metadata, storage keys, preset popular cities.
Bilingual dictionaries (Arabic RTL and English LTR) with instant translation binding.

layers.name: Domain Logic Layer
layers.responsibility: Encapsulates meteorological formulas, thresholds, spatial calculations, and formatters.

files.role: Conversions between Metric and Imperial (C/F, km/h/mph, mm/in, hPa/inHg, Magnus dew point).
Maps WMO codes (0-99) to bilingual descriptions, atmospheric modes, and inline SVG icons.
Categorization and health advice for Dust (µg/m³), UV Index, and US AQI.
Meteorological alert engine evaluating heatwaves, freezes, winds, downpours, dust storms, UV, and cyclones.
Spatial Haversine distance formula, knot-to-km/h conversion, cyclone severity classes.
High-precision live local city clock calculation using UTC offsets, dates via Intl, and Western digits.
Handcrafted SVG sparklines, area charts, and solar path curve calculations.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Data Layer
layers.responsibility: Network communication, API integrations, caching strategies, and persistent storage.

files.role: Safe localStorage wrapper, 10-minute weather cache validation, 5km distance check, FIFO prune (max 8 cities).
Fetch client with 18-second timeout, AbortController, exponential retry backoff.
Open-Meteo Weather Forecast endpoint client.
Open-Meteo Air Quality & Dust endpoint client.
City search via Open-Meteo Geocoding & reverse geocoding via BigDataCloud/Nominatim.
NASA EONET Severe Storms API with distance sorting and graceful degradation.

dataFlow.step1_init: Main bootstrap reads saved settings and selected city from localStorage (defaults to Cairo).
dataFlow.step2_cacheCheck: Checks if valid unexpired weather cache (<10 min old, within 5km) exists for the city.
dataFlow.step3_concurrentFetch: If cache expired or missing, initiates Promise.allSettled across Open-Meteo Forecast, Air Quality, and NASA EONET.
dataFlow.step4_rawCacheStorage: Raw API JSON responses are safely stored in localStorage under ajwaa.weather.v1.{cityId}.
dataFlow.step5_stateUpdate: Store receives parsed objects, flags loading=false, and notifies all subscribed UI components.
dataFlow.step6_domRendering: Components re-render hero, alerts, hourly timeline, rain/dust, details, sun arc, storms, and 7-day forecast.
dataFlow.step7_liveTick: A lightweight 1-second interval updates the hero live clock (HH:MM:SS) in place without re-rendering the whole page.

properties.cities: Array of City objects { id, name, nameEn, lat, lon, country, timezone }

ajwaa.selectedCity.v1.description: Active city object currently viewed by the user.

ajwaa.onboardingSeen.v1.description: Flag indicating if the user has dismissed the first-time welcome dialog.

apiContracts.query: latitude, longitude, timezone=auto, current=..., hourly=..., daily=...

errorHandling.networkTimeout: 18-second timeout with AbortController, retried up to 3 times with 350ms exponential backoff.
errorHandling.offlineWithCache: Displays cached weather data immediately, renders yellow offline banner informing user of cached status.
errorHandling.offlineWithoutCache: Displays user-friendly error screen with clear explanation in active language and Retry button.
errorHandling.apiPartialFailure: If Air Quality or NASA EONET fails, main weather forecast still renders completely; storm card displays graceful calm/unavailable state.
errorHandling.corruptLocalStorage: Wrapped in try/catch; resets invalid keys to default Cairo values without throwing or halting execution.

testStrategy: Verify zero console errors on startup across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.
Test GPS location retrieval and reverse geocoding fallback.
Search global cities (Arabic and English) with debounce verification.
Verify saved cities persistence across page reloads and FIFO cache cleanup.
Test AR/EN toggle for instant text, font direction, and icon flips.
Test Metric to Imperial unit conversions across temperatures, wind, and rain.
Verify live local clock ticks every second with accurate timezone offset for foreign cities.
Test offline mode by disconnecting network to observe cached banner.
